---
title: "Agora: tep_adi_info.csv"
---

Related JIRA issues: EX-258

This notebook supports updating Agora's tep_adi_info.csv file to incorporate new TEP targets based on the TREAT-AD Target Portfolio smartsheet and optional direct input from the TREAT-AD PM.

Note that there is currently no support for incorporating new ADI targets since there are no known plans to update that set.

# Install packages
```{r eval=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
source("../utils.R")
prepare()
```

# Prerequisites
1. Copy the target list from column 1 of the tracking Smartsheet: https://app.smartsheet.com/sheets/pC2Mp7vW6v5768RhMfhqQxrWRW7Jq7cxgHXwFGc1?view=grid&newview=true

2. Ask your AI friend to reformat the copied values into a valid R vector of strings, then replace the current `target_list` below with that formatted list

3. Ask the TREAT-AD PM If there are pending targets we should include.
-> if yes, replace `pending_target_list` below with that list
-> if no, update `pending_target_list` below to be an empty vector


# Download current version of the tep_adi_info source file
```{r echo=FALSE}
tep_adi_info <- download_file("syn51942280", "not used", type = "csv")
gene_info <- download_file("syn12548902", "not used", type = "json")
```

# Generate the updated target list

```{r}
# 1. Combine lists, normalize aliases to official HGNC symbols, and deduplicate
raw_targets <- c(target_list, pending_target_list)
alias_map <- c("ASC" = "PYCARD", "MDA5" = "IFIH1")

all_targets <- coalesce(alias_map[raw_targets], raw_targets) %>%
  unique()

# 2. Update existing rows in tep_adi_info (preserves existing is_adi values)
updated_existing <- tep_adi_info %>%
  mutate(
    is_tep = if_else(hgnc_symbol %in% all_targets, TRUE, is_tep)
  )

# 3. Build rows for genes not yet in tep_adi_info and resolve ENSG IDs
new_rows <- tibble(hgnc_symbol = setdiff(all_targets, tep_adi_info$hgnc_symbol)) %>%
  left_join(
    gene_info %>% distinct(hgnc_symbol, ensembl_gene_id),
    by = "hgnc_symbol"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    is_adi = NA,
    is_tep = TRUE
  ) %>%
  select(all_of(names(tep_adi_info)))

# 4. Combine into the final updated table and sort alphabetically by symbol
tep_adi_info_updated <- bind_rows(updated_existing, new_rows) %>%
  arrange(hgnc_symbol)

# 5. QC checks
unresolved_genes <- new_rows %>% filter(is.na(ensembl_gene_id))
duplicate_mappings <- new_rows %>% dplyr::count(hgnc_symbol) %>% filter(n > 1)

tep_adi_info_updated
assert (nrow(unresolved_genes) == 0)
assert (nrow(duplicate_mappings) == 0)
```

# Sanity check the updated list
```{r}

# 1. New rows added to tep_adi_info_updated
new_rows_added <- tep_adi_info_updated %>%
  anti_join(tep_adi_info, by = "hgnc_symbol")

cat("=== 1. New Rows Added ===\n")
cat("Total count:", nrow(new_rows_added), "\n")
cat(
  "HGNC symbols:",
  ifelse(nrow(new_rows_added) > 0, paste(new_rows_added$hgnc_symbol, collapse = ", "), "None"),
  "\n\n"
)

# 2. Existing rows where is_tep changed (handles NA -> TRUE safely)
changed_rows <- tep_adi_info %>%
  inner_join(
    tep_adi_info_updated,
    by = "hgnc_symbol",
    suffix = c("_old", "_new")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    (is.na(is_tep_old) & !is.na(is_tep_new)) |
    (!is.na(is_tep_old) & is.na(is_tep_new)) |
    (is_tep_old != is_tep_new)
  )

cat("=== 2. Existing Rows Where is_tep Changed ===\n")
cat("Total count:", nrow(changed_rows), "\n")
cat(
  "HGNC symbols:",
  ifelse(nrow(changed_rows) > 0, paste(changed_rows$hgnc_symbol, collapse = ", "), "None"),
  "\n\n"
)

# 3. Pending targets that already had is_tep == TRUE in the original table
clean_pending <- coalesce(alias_map[pending_target_list], pending_target_list) %>%
  unique()

pending_already_tep <- tep_adi_info %>%
  filter(hgnc_symbol %in% clean_pending, is_tep)

cat("=== 3. Pending Targets Already Marked is_tep == TRUE ===\n")
cat("Total count:", nrow(pending_already_tep), "\n")
cat(
  "HGNC symbols:",
  ifelse(nrow(pending_already_tep) > 0, paste(pending_already_tep$hgnc_symbol, collapse = ", "), "None"),
  "\n"
)
```

# Generate csv

```{r}
write_csv(tep_adi_info_updated, file.path(output_dir, "tep_adi_info.csv"))
```



# Upload to synapse
*********************************************************
Validate file in ./output directory before upload
*********************************************************
```{r}
synLogin()
syn_file <- File(
              file.path(output_dir, "tep_adi_info.csv"),
              description = "Agora: TEP and ADI target list",
              parent = "syn7525089"
            )

data_sources <- c("https://treatad.org/data-tools/target-dashboard/")

res <- synStore(
          syn_file,
          forceVersion = FALSE,
          used = data_sources
        )
# print synapse_id and new version number
print(paste0("ID: ", res$id, " v", res$versionNumber, ", Name: ", res$name))

```
